crossRefs.note: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for king Solomon…
the pots; the shovels; and the basins: even all these vessels, which Hiram made for king Solomon, in Yahweh’s house…

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for king Solomon in God’s house:
translations.bsb: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of God:
translations.kjv: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
translations.asv: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basins. So Huram made an end of doing the work that he wrought for king Solomon in the house of God:
